title: US-short §13 lifecycle readiness artifact — the TRACKED, de-identified due-scan summary the weekly_report lifecycle section + top banner consume (§13 / §11.6 脱敏汇总)
description: Batch-3 TRACKED de-identified summary of the §13.1 lifecycle due scan (engine/us_short_lifecycle_readiness builds it from a §13-clean register via evaluate_lifecycle). UNLIKE the PRIVATE lifecycle_register (per-item live-forward counts + later ticker/performance detail → gitignored, §11.6), this artifact carries ONLY normalized indicators — §13.1 item NUMBERS and aggregate counts, NO ticker names, NO $, NO performance — so it is safe to TRACK (§11.6 要 tracked 只能放脱敏汇总). additionalProperties:false + integer-only item fields structurally guarantee no ticker / performance detail can be smuggled into a tracked artifact, so engine/us_short_lifecycle_readiness validates a built / to-be-written artifact against THIS schema as the de-identification gate (no §18.0 private-path guard is needed — being provably de-identified is exactly what §11.6 lets land on a tracked path). The weekly_report lifecycle section + §11.2 top banner render from this; the §11.2 count reconcile (第1节与对应节一致) checks against it. Structure-only: the welded `due_count == len(due_items)` consistency, item-numbers-within-range, upgrade ⊆ due, and the as_of strict REAL-date (the `as_of` pattern here only checks 8 digits — it cannot reject an impossible calendar date like 20260231) are enforced by engine/us_short_lifecycle_readiness + tests.
